replace: > This file extends [common/testing.md](../common/testing.md) with TypeScript/JavaScript specific content.

Use **Playwright** as the E2E testing framework for critical user flows when relevant to the changed behavior and configured in the project. Task scope and existing project runners select checks; this guidance adds no compulsory E2E run, coverage threshold, or reviewer.

Refer to included `rule://ecc-wp3-common-testing` for shared test structure, AAA pattern, test isolation, mock verification, and troubleshooting test failures. An independent audit is explicitly optional and never compulsory. Existing project runners select checks; commands, if included, are task-scoped project-guidance examples (OMP TS uses `bun check` for typechecking). No coverage, reviewer, approval, commit, push, or hook mandate.
